description: This source file contains SwiftUI-based smoke tests for the CronJobEditor component in the OpenClaw project. It tests the UI construction and behavior for different scenarios of the CronJobEditor, including building its body for new and existing jobs, and testing specific functionalities like delete after run timing.

classes.name: CronJobEditorSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for testing the CronJobEditor UI component and related functions.

methods.name: makeEditor
methods.description: Creates an instance of CronJobEditor with optional job and channelsStore for testing purposes.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: Optional CronJob object to load into the editor.

parameters.name: channelsStore
parameters.description: Optional ChannelsStore object; defaults to a preview store.

methods.name: `status pill builds body`
methods.description: Tests the construction of StatusPill components with different statuses.

methods.name: `cron job editor builds body for new job`
methods.description: Tests the creation of the CronJobEditor view for a new job.

methods.name: `cron job editor builds body for existing job`
methods.description: Tests the creation of the CronJobEditor view with a pre-existing job loaded.

methods.name: `cron job editor exercises builders`
methods.description: Runs testing exercises on the CronJobEditor view.

methods.name: `cron job editor includes delete after run for at schedule`
methods.description: Tests the behavior of scheduling delete after run in the editor.
